newsitem.title: RUSSIA: St Petersburg to hold roadshow after May 20.
newsitem.headline: St Petersburg to hold roadshow after May 20.

text.p: The city administration of St Petersburg will hold a roadshow for its planned Eurobond issue after May 20, a spokeswoman of the city's finance committee said on Wednesday.

"The process of selling St Petersburg Eurobonds is starting," Olga Pokrovskaya told Reuters. "The trip by city officials' to Europe, the United States and some Asian states will start after May 20 and they will hold a series of presentations."
She did not give other details.
The City of Moscow is planning a roadshow for its Eurobond on May 11-23.
St Petersburg plans to issue up to $300 million in two to five-year Eurobonds.
Salomon Brothers is the lead-manager of the issue.
